---

config:
    theme: 'base'
    themeVariables:
        primaryColor: '#1f2020'
        primaryTextColor: '#f0f0f0'
        background: '#333'
        primaryBorderColor: '#888888'
        lineColor: '#999'

---

stateDiagram

state "MANETTA" as MANETTA {

        %% Initial state name as "." so that it fits in black circle shape.
        %% See https://github.com/StateSmith/StateSmith/issues/404
        state "." as MANETTA.(InitialState)

        OFF

        OFF : OFF

        OFF : enter / { power_relay_on = false; set_power(OFF); }

        OFF : TURN_OFF / { set_reply(OK); }

        OFF : (START_BREW, ENTER_STEAM) / { set_reply(NOT_READY); }

        state "ON" as ON {

                %% Initial state name as "." so that it fits in black circle shape.
                %% See https://github.com/StateSmith/StateSmith/issues/404
                state "." as ON.(InitialState)

                IDLE

                IDLE : IDLE

                IDLE : 1. START_BREW [cmd_max_ms == 0] / { set_reply(INVALID); }

                IDLE : 2. START_BREW [cmd_max_ms != 0 && !power_is(READY)] / { set_reply(NOT_READY); }

                IDLE : 1. ENTER_STEAM [cmd_max_ms == 0] / { set_reply(INVALID); }

                IDLE : 2. ENTER_STEAM [cmd_max_ms != 0 && power_is(HEATING)] / { set_reply(NOT_READY); }

                BREWING

                BREWING : BREWING

                BREWING : enter / { set_phase(BREWING); set_stop_reason(NONE); pump_on = true; brew_started_at = now_ms; }

                BREWING : exit / { pump_on = false; set_phase(IDLE); auto_off_from = now_ms; }

                BREWING : TURN_OFF / { set_reply(BUSY); }

                state "STEAM" as STEAM {

                        %% Initial state name as "." so that it fits in black circle shape.
                        %% See https://github.com/StateSmith/StateSmith/issues/404
                        state "." as STEAM.(InitialState)

                        STEAM_HEATING

                        STEAM_HEATING : STEAM_HEATING

                        STEAM_HEATING : enter / { set_steam_state(HEATING); }

                        STEAM_READY

                        STEAM_READY : STEAM_READY

                        STEAM_READY : enter / { set_steam_state(READY); }

                }

        }

        FAULT

        FAULT : FAULT

        FAULT : enter / { set_phase(FAULT); }

        FAULT : exit / { set_phase(IDLE); }

        FAULT : (TURN_ON, START_BREW, ENTER_STEAM) / { set_reply(FAULT); }

        FAULT : TURN_OFF / { set_reply(OK); power_relay_on = false; set_power(OFF); }

        FAULT : FAULT_DETECTED / {  }

        state MANETTA.(ChoicePoint)(AFTER_FAULT) <>

}

%% Initial state name as "." so that it fits in black circle shape.
%% See https://github.com/StateSmith/StateSmith/issues/404
state "." as ROOT.(InitialState)

MANETTA --> FAULT : FAULT_DETECTED

MANETTA.(InitialState) --> OFF

OFF --> ON : TURN_ON / { set_reply(OK); }

OFF --> ON : MACHINE_POWER_SWITCH

ON --> OFF : TURN_OFF / { set_reply(OK); }

ON --> OFF : MACHINE_POWER_SWITCH

ON.(InitialState) --> IDLE

IDLE --> BREWING : 3. START_BREW [cmd_max_ms != 0 && power_is(READY)] / { set_reply(OK); set_start_source(APP); brew_cmd_max_ms = cmd_max_ms; }

IDLE --> BREWING : MACHINE_BREW_SWITCH_ON / { set_start_source(MACHINE); }

IDLE --> STEAM : 3. ENTER_STEAM [cmd_max_ms != 0 && !power_is(HEATING)] / { set_reply(OK); steam_cmd_max_ms = cmd_max_ms; }

IDLE --> STEAM : MACHINE_STEAM_BUTTON [!power_is(HEATING)] / { steam_cmd_max_ms = device_max_steam_ms; }

IDLE --> OFF : do [elapsed(auto_off_from) #62;= minutes(auto_off_min)]

BREWING --> IDLE : 1. do [started_by(APP) && elapsed(brew_started_at) #62;= brew_cmd_max_ms] / { set_stop_reason(COMMAND_CAP); }

BREWING --> IDLE : 2. do [elapsed(brew_started_at) #62;= device_max_brew_ms] / { set_stop_reason(DEVICE_CAP); }

BREWING --> IDLE : 3. do [started_by(APP) && elapsed(last_write_at) #62;= heartbeat_timeout_ms] / { set_stop_reason(HEARTBEAT); }

BREWING --> IDLE : STOP_BREW / { set_reply(OK); set_stop_reason(APP); }

BREWING --> IDLE : MACHINE_BREW_SWITCH_OFF / { set_stop_reason(MACHINE); }

BREWING --> IDLE : LINK_LOST [started_by(APP)] / { set_stop_reason(LINK_LOST); }

BREWING --> OFF : MACHINE_POWER_SWITCH / { set_stop_reason(MACHINE); }

BREWING --> FAULT : FAULT_DETECTED / { set_stop_reason(FAULT); }

STEAM --> IDLE : LEAVE_STEAM / { set_reply(OK); }

STEAM --> IDLE : MACHINE_STEAM_BUTTON

STEAM --> IDLE : 1. do [elapsed(steam_cmd_at) #62;= steam_cmd_max_ms]

STEAM --> IDLE : 2. do [elapsed(steam_started_at) #62;= device_max_steam_ms]

STEAM --> OFF : 3. do [elapsed(auto_off_from) #62;= minutes(auto_off_min)]

STEAM.(InitialState) --> STEAM_HEATING

STEAM_HEATING --> STEAM_READY : TEMP_READY

FAULT --> MANETTA.(ChoicePoint)(AFTER_FAULT) : FAULT_CLEARED

MANETTA.(ChoicePoint)(AFTER_FAULT) --> ON :  [power_relay_on]

MANETTA.(ChoicePoint)(AFTER_FAULT) --> OFF : else

ROOT.(InitialState) --> MANETTA
StateSmith Simulator
